design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (nfip_commercial_rcbap_claims), rework round 2
DRAW: draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5,4]; payment policy took 5, proof-of-loss policy took 4.
WHY A GOOD TEST: a condominium board asks only for 'the additional building money' after the adjuster's SUPPLEMENTAL report. Getting the number right needs (1) discovering from the payment rule that a building proof of loss received after the latest building-measuring report must stand first, and handing that sworn statement to the authorized signer (owner=user write); (2) computing the supplemental amount sworn: the governing report, the RCBAP coinsurance measured against the building's replacement cost value at the time of loss (the BizFlood adjuster's measured value), the FEMA minimum deductible, and the subtraction of what is already sworn; (3) computing the payment under the other-insurance condition the RCBAP and the General Property Form both carry (44 CFR 61 App. A(3) VIII.B.1 / App. A(2) VII.B.1: primary, subject to its own deductible, up to the other flood policy's deductible, then pro rata by amounts of insurance) against the association's BizFlood Building and Contents policy in force on the loss date, the BizFlood deductible layer shared between building and contents in proportion to their sworn amounts because that policy insures both, less the payment already made under a duplicate first notice. One unlock/call pair per problem.
SCOPE: task 0 claims nfipcom_ext_building_proof_amount + nfipcom_ext_building_payment and tools sign_building_proof_of_loss_d76eab34 (user) / issue_building_claim_payment_972d0779 (agent). Task 1 keeps the contents proof of loss, contents payment, cancellation processing and refund disbursement.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root nfipcom_ext_building_payment <- nfipcom_ext_building_proof_amount; kind value_input; gate pb_sworn; form state; prerequisite sentence (negated direction): 'A building payment on a claim is not issued until the claim file carries a signed and sworn building proof of loss received after the claim's latest adjuster report that measures a building loss.' Four-point test: connective 'not ... until'; record-visible state (a BUILDING proof-of-loss entry dated after the latest building-measuring report); no tool/id/code token; closed to building proofs. Exactly one write of the difficulty creates a BUILDING proof-of-loss entry: sign_building_proof_of_loss_d76eab34. Unmet at opening: SUPPLEMENTAL row event_date 2026-10-09 vs building proof row event_date 2026-09-25; nothing under 2608311. Order: proof (step 9) then payment (step 11). Deletion sensitivity: skipping the proof -> payment 0.00 instead of 25,939.64.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: step 9 subject nfipcom_proof_of_loss_filed -> nfipcom_proof_of_loss.pol_deadline (time): date of loss 2026-08-27 + 60 days = 2026-10-26 inclusive; frozen_time 2026-10-14 satisfies. Step 11 subject nfipcom_claim_paid -> nfipcom_claim_settlement (overwrite of the 'A new payment on a coverage is the payable amount less what has already been paid net of voids...' clause, scoped to building payments, the contents payment named as its sibling) and nfipcom_proof_of_loss. The proof-of-loss policy overwrites the base required-insurance clause only for a building amount sworn on a proof of loss (replacement cost value at the time of loss). Coinsurance is applied only on a tier where coinsurance applies (the RCBAP tiers; the General Property Form has no coinsurance condition), matching the SFIP forms. The deductible floor uses base's own minimum building deductibles (44 CFR 61.5: 1,000 up to a 100,000 limit, 1,250 above).
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: claim 2608274 (carries every adjuster report), date of loss 2026-08-27, RCBAP RC2049318. Included: PRELIMINARY/FINAL/SUPPLEMENTAL reports; building proof 467,870.00; contents proof 26,800.00; building payment 299,528.59 booked under the duplicate first notice 2608311; BizFlood BF2203117 (BizFlood Building and Contents tier: the association, a non-profit corporation, owns the building and its common contents) rows for the same address and date of loss. Excluded: the contents payment from the building payments.
WORLD CONSISTENCY: the first building proof 467,870 = 586,400 x 2,400,000 / 3,000,000 - 1,250 (same evidenced value and deductible floor the rules give); the 2026-10-01 building payment 299,528.59 is the payment rule on that day's file; contents 26,800 = 31,800 - 5,000 paid as 20,248.31 under the contents payment rule because the BizFlood policy also insures the association's common contents (60,000); BizFlood term premium re-rated on the value endorsement ((4,400,000 x 0.62 + 60,000 x 0.71) / 100 x 2.6 = 72,035.60) and total insured value updated to 4,460,000.
FACTOR CARD (sensitivity run with a scratch evaluator built on the check_compute engine):
 proof (expected 67,880.00; all-baseline 487,666.67): report_choice P -> SUPPLEMENTAL (baseline FINAL -> 0.00); value_basis P cross -> 4,250,000 measured at loss (baseline RCV 3,600,000 -> 90,255.00); deductible_floor P -> 1,250 (baseline 1,000 -> 68,130.00); prior_sworn M -> 467,870.00 (baseline nothing -> 535,750.00).
 payment (expected 25,939.64; all-baseline 67,880.00): sworn_total M -> 535,750 (baseline latest -> 0.00); alone_layer P cross MS -> 212,500 (baseline no layer -> 236,221.41); contents_share P -> 26,800 (baseline 0 -> 32,325.26); other_cover P cross MS -> 4,100,000 (baseline none -> 236,221.41); paid_before P -> 299,528.59 via duplicate notice (baseline 0 -> 325,468.23).
 Near-misses: the BizFlood value increase to 4,400,000 recorded 2026-09-12 but effective 2026-09-27 (after the loss); the SOV value 4,100,000 beside the measured 4,250,000; PRELIMINARY and FINAL figures beside the SUPPLEMENTAL; the payment under 2608311 instead of 2608274.
TIER TABLES (one distinguishing input per pair): report_choice SUPP/FINAL: a later SUPPLEMENTAL with building > 0; PRELIM/FINAL: FINAL present. value_basis measured/SOV: BizFlood adjuster report for the date of loss present; SOV/policy: in-force SOV value above the policy RCV. deductible_floor higher/lower minimum: limit vs threshold; minimum/shown: renewal charge with a below-minimum deductible. prior_sworn (method: sum of sworn proofs vs payments net of voids vs none) proofs/paid-in-lieu: a timely proof on the claim; paid-in-lieu/none: building payments on the claim. sworn_total (method: sum less the late proof vs sum of all vs latest only) drop-late/sum: latest proof late; sum/latest: more than one proof. alone_layer V-zone/flat: flood zone; flat/none: in-force non-excess BizFlood scheduling the address. contents_share (every tier requires the BizFlood policy to insure contents at the address) late/all/paid/none: latest contents proof late; contents proof present; contents payments with no proof. other_cover endorsed/SOV: a value endorsement in force on the date of loss (the later-effective of the latest increase and the latest decrease among those effective on or before it); SOV/none: in-force BizFlood scheduling the address. paid_before dup/void/net: duplicate notice; void with no later payment.
FACTOR INDEPENDENCE (factor -> what it reads): report_choice -> adjuster reports of the claim; value_basis -> BizFlood SOV, BizFlood adjuster reports, the BizFlood policy's in-force dates, policy RCV; deductible_floor -> policy limit and deductible, renewal charges, tier minimums; prior_sworn -> building proofs and payments of the claim; sworn_total -> building proofs for the date of loss; alone_layer -> in-force BizFlood policy and tier, SOV, flood zone, BizFlood adjuster value; contents_share -> the BizFlood SOV contents value, contents proofs and payments for the date of loss; other_cover -> BizFlood value endorsements and SOV; paid_before -> first notices, building payments and voids. No factor reads another factor's binding; required insurance, coinsurance, carried-alone part, share and result are plain assembly stated once (order: reduction for under-insurance, deductible, limit, already sworn / part carried alone, share of the rest, payments already made).
PROBE TABLE (scratch copies): the BizFlood policy meant is the one whose statement of values schedules the address, its location the one that statement gives the address, counted only when in force on the date of loss (on or after its effective date, before its term end and any cancellation effective date) -> a policy cancelled after the loss still counts, one that began after the loss or was cancelled before it does not (no layer, no other insurance, value basis falls to the policy RCV unless its adjuster measured the loss); BizFlood Excess over NFIP tier -> primary for the whole loss; a second SOV scheduling the address (on the same or another BizFlood policy), or a second value increase or value decrease for the address -> the payment is nil and referred to the adjuster, the proof amount takes the policy's own replacement cost value or contents limit; an increase and a decrease effective the same day -> the one recorded later, the increase when recorded the same day; an in-force BizFlood policy scheduling the address with no adjuster report for the date of loss -> still other insurance, the V/VE layer taken on the SOV building and contents values for the location; a BizFlood term ended before the loss -> not in force; LOCATION_ADD/DELETE endorsements -> not value endorsements; a PRELIMINARY filed the same day as the FINAL -> the FINAL governs; a second first notice under the same claim number -> not a duplicate claim number; a value increase in force on the loss date with a decrease effective after it -> the increase sets the limit; neither in force -> the SOV; a BizFlood policy writing no contents -> the building carries the whole layer; no SUPPLEMENTAL -> FINAL; no FINAL -> PRELIMINARY; no earlier proof -> nothing sworn; proof under the duplicate number -> subtracted as sworn under it; no duplicate notice -> payments on the claim net of voids; voided payment not yet reissued -> counted as paid. Rounding half-up at every step (a tie such as 0.005 rounds up).
PERSONA: Lydia Jessup, board treasurer and authorized signer; volunteers only the flood date, the adjuster's return visit and the ask; gives phone 7135521846 and tax ID 2417 when asked; policy/claim numbers on request; no lender; BizFlood bought in January; a building payment arrived early October; signs whatever is handed with the figures given; closes on the payment confirmation.
STANDARD SOLUTION: locate (phone), verify (phone + tax id), read the policy, claims, billing, BizFlood policy/changes/claims; compute the supplemental proof 67,880.00 and hand the signing to the user; compute and issue the building payment 25,939.64 payee INSURED.
VERIFICATION: gates run per task (see worklog.md).
user_scenario: You are Lydia Jessup, the volunteer treasurer of the board of Harrow Pointe Condominium Association, Inc., a twelve-unit oceanfront condominium building at 236 San Luis Pass Road, Galveston, TX 77554. You are organized, a retired bookkeeper, polite but brisk, and you keep the association's papers in a binder in front of you. You are on the association's authorized-signer list for its flood insurance with Tidemark. You are calling because of the flood on August 27, 2026. The adjuster came back on October 9 after the contractors opened up the walls and the elevator pit and found more damage to the building than was in his first report, and he filed an updated report. You want Tidemark to pay the association the additional building money that comes from that updated report, today if it can be done. You are fine with the representative issuing the payment for the association; you do not want anything else changed on the policy. You do not know any figures from the updated report and you do not know what the additional amount should be; if asked what amount you expect, you say you are relying on Tidemark to work it out from the adjuster's report. Only when the representative asks you to confirm who you are do you give the association's phone number, 7135521846, and the last four digits of the association's tax ID, 2417; you give them one at a time as asked. If asked for the policy number you read RC2049318, and if asked for the claim number you read 2608274 from the adjuster's letter. If asked whether there is a mortgage or lender on the building, you say the association owns the building outright and there is no lender. If asked whether the association has any other flood insurance on the building, you say that in January the board also bought a BizFlood policy from Tidemark for the building, and that you do not have its details at hand. If asked whether the association has already received a building payment for this flood, you say a building check arrived at the beginning of October and you do not have the amount in front of you. If asked about any other claim number, you say the only claim number you were given is 2608274. If the representative explains that something has to be signed or sworn by you as the authorized signer and hands it to you with the amount it states, you sign it as handed to you, exactly once, with the figures the representative gives you, and you tell the representative what the confirmation shows. If the representative tells you a figure, you do not dispute it; you only ask them to repeat it so you can write it down. Once the representative tells you the additional building payment has been issued and gives you its amount or its payment reference, you write it down, thank them, and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the claim file: first notices 2608274 and 2608311 (same date of loss), PRELIMINARY/FINAL/SUPPLEMENTAL reports, the contents and first building proofs of loss, the contents payment and the building payment issued under 2608311.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the premium account: renewal risk premium charges for the 2025 and 2026 terms.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The deductible-floor factor raises a below-minimum deductible only when the account shows a renewal risk premium charge.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the association's BizFlood Building and Contents policy BF2203117: tier, status active since 2026-01-29, flat deductible 25,000.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The value-basis, deductible-layer and other-insurance factors decide their tier from this BizFlood policy (in force on the date of loss, not written excess of the NFIP).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the BizFlood statement of values (building value 4,100,000 and contents value 60,000 at the same address, zone VE) and its value increase to 4,400,000 effective 2026-09-27.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The value-basis factor reads the declared building value; the other-insurance factor needs the value endorsement and its effective date against the date of loss.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the BizFlood adjuster report for the same date of loss and location: replacement cost value of the location at the time of loss 4,250,000.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The value-basis factor takes this measured value; the deductible-layer factor computes the BizFlood V-zone deductible from it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the building proof-of-loss signing action to hand it to the authorized signer.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the user hand-over; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The authorized signer swears the supplemental building proof of loss for the additional building amount; the claim file then carries a building proof of loss after the SUPPLEMENTAL report.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: nfipcom_ext_building_proof_amount computes claimed_amount; the payment policy waits on a building proof of loss received after the latest building-measuring report.
